## R resources

The course uses R and RStudio. See the optional textbook or your lecture notes for a refresher.

### Interactive applications

The source code for the course Shiny applications is available below. These require R with the `shiny` package; run them locally with `shiny::runApp("filename.R")`.

- [Sampling distribution simulator](../apps/clt_simulator.r)
- [Discrete central limit theorem simulator](../apps/clt_discrete.r)
- [Confidence level visualization](../apps/confidence_levels.r)
- [Hypothesis testing visualization](../apps/hypothesis_testing.r)
- [DINA Bayesian explorer](../apps/dina_app.r)
